description: The bar chart illustrates a comparison of four methods — CoT, CoD, CCoT, and CoUT — across two metrics: Accuracy (%) on the left y-axis (ranging from 70 to 100) and Token Count on the right y-axis (ranging from 0 to 800), with each method represented by a distinct color-coded bar pair. The red bar for CoT shows the highest accuracy at 91.19% and the highest token count at 676.85; the orange bar for CoD has the lowest accuracy at 80.89% and a token count of 534.24; the light blue bar for CCoT achieves 88.50% accuracy with 445.91 tokens; and the green bar for CoUT achieves 88.40% accuracy with 354.46 tokens. The bars are arranged left to right in the order CoT, CoD, CCoT, CoUT, with no sorting by value. The chart visually emphasizes CoT’s superior accuracy at the cost of higher token usage, while CoUT achieves near-comparable accuracy with significantly fewer tokens. The legend at the bottom matches each method to its color, and each bar is labeled with its exact numerical value.
